notes: One prohibitive אַל governs both cola and the ASV rewrites it as not at the head of the second, so no and both belong to that morpheme's discontinuous unit (rule 25).
The assignment of proudly and so exceeding between the two identical adjectives is not otherwise determined; the unit note records the competing reading.
The margin's alternative (Though actions be not weighed) was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38). Variant unit v001 selected the base reading, which the ASV's by him follows.
